## Discrepancies

### DISC-1: Tool handler locations do not match FSD §2.2 [High]
- **FSD says:** §2.2 places all 8 tool handlers at `backend/src/engine/tools/*.ts` via `register-tools.ts`; §2.2 table implies one backend surface.
- **Actual codebase:** Only 3 of the 8 live in `backend/src/engine/tools/` (`drawio-tool.ts`, `drawio-export-png.ts`, `code-intel-handlers.ts` for `stream_write_file`). `jira_attach_file` and `confluence_add_attachment` live in `backend/src/servers/atlassian/tools/` with their **own** containment implementation (`ALLOWED_BASES = [process.cwd()]` at `jira-attachment-tools.ts:17`, `validateFilePath` at `:66` and confluence `:65`). `embed_image`, the extension variant of `stream_write_file`, and the `mem_ingest_file` pre-read proxy execute in the VS Code extension (`extension/src/backend-local-tools/embed-image.ts`, `extension/src/services/Base64ProxyService.ts:177`) and cannot import backend ESM modules.
- **Impact:** A DEV following FSD §2.2 literally would modify the wrong files and would leave a second, divergent containment implementation (`ALLOWED_BASES`) in place — violating BR-20 (uniform behavior) and the no-workaround rule.
- **Recommended fix (applied in TDD):** TDD §3.3 + §6.2 list the verified integration point per tool (real file + function), §6.3 defines the extension adapter via the existing `extension/src/services/PathResolver.ts`, and §6.4 mandates replacing `ALLOWED_BASES`/`validateFilePath` with the shared resolver. FSD §2.2 should be corrected to point at the real locations.
- **Resolution:** Handled in TDD v1.0 (no FSD update strictly required for DEV to proceed; BA may sync FSD §2.2 for accuracy).

### DISC-2: sandbox_run parameter is `file`, not `file_path` [Low]
- **FSD says:** §3.3.4 groups `sandbox_run` under the `file_path` tools; §3.3.6 says `file_path` is required on all 8 tools.
- **Actual codebase:** `backend/src/modules/sandbox/tools/tool-definitions.ts:70` — `sandbox_run` schema uses `file` ("Path to the file inside the sandbox"); `sandbox_exec` uses `workdir`. No `file_path` parameter exists.
- **Impact:** Literal implementation would add a dead `file_path` parameter; the real argument would stay un-resolved.
- **Recommended fix (applied in TDD):** TDD §3.3 applies the resolver to the `file` argument (host-side, pre-mount into the sandbox); noted in Open Questions #3. FSD §3.3.4 row for sandbox_run should say "`file`".

### DISC-3: stream_write_file parameter naming is inconsistent across backend surfaces [Low]
- **FSD says:** one tool `stream_write_file` with `file_path`.
- **Actual codebase:** The module-registry definition/handler uses `path` (`backend/src/modules/utility/UtilityModule.ts:59,109`), while the code-intel definition uses `file_path` (`backend/src/engine/tools/register-tools.ts:74`) and the extension variant uses `file_path` (`extension/src/backend-local-tools/stream-write.ts`).
- **Impact:** `base_dir` must work regardless of which parameter name the caller uses; a single-name implementation would break one of the three surfaces.
- **Recommended fix (applied in TDD):** TDD §3.3 requires both `path` and `file_path` names to be accepted and routed through the resolver on every surface.

### DISC-4: drawio_export_png `file_path` is reference-only in the backend; `output_path` is extension-side [Low]
- **FSD says:** §3.3.4 — `drawio_export_png`: ".drawio source file (+ optional output) — Read (+ write if output_path)".
- **Actual codebase:** Backend definition only has `content_base64` (required) + `file_path` (description: "reference only") — `backend/src/engine/tools/drawio-export-png.ts:14-25`; the backend writes to a temp dir and returns `output_base64`. The `output_path` write-back exists only in the extension output proxy (`extension/src/services/Base64ProxyService/output-proxy.ts:59`).
- **Impact:** `base_dir` on the backend handler can only validate/resolve `file_path` (reference) — the actual output write must be handled in the extension adapter.
- **Recommended fix (applied in TDD):** TDD §3.3 row for drawio_export_png assigns `file_path` (reference) + `output_path` (extension proxy) as the resolver-touched parameters.

### DISC-5: FSD defers config-file format to TDD (format now defined) [Low]
- **FSD says:** §3.2.4 "one entry per line or documented format (TDD §4)".
- **Actual codebase / decision:** No existing workspace-roots config file mechanism exists; `MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOTS` env is new.
- **Impact:** none — this is the deferred decision, not a conflict.
- **Recommended fix (applied in TDD):** TDD §4.2 defines the normative format (one root per line, `#` comments, blank lines skipped) and precedence (env var → file → legacy mode).

## Resolution (BA Sync — Feedback Loop Iteration 1, Closed 2026-11-01)

FSD synced in place to **v1.1** (Revision History: `1.1 | 2026-11-01 | BA Agent | Synced with TDD per DISCREPANCY.md (DISC-1..DISC-5)`). TDD v1.0 remains the technical source of truth; corrections verified against TDD §3.3, §4.2, §6.3, §6.4.

- **DISC-1 (High): RESOLVED — FSD v1.1 §2.2.** Tool-handler table replaced with the REAL locations per TDD §3.3: 3 backend engine tools (`drawio-tool.ts`, `drawio-export-png.ts`, `code-intel-handlers.ts`), backend module handlers (`UtilityModule.ts` for stream_write_file `path` variant, sandbox `tool-handlers.ts` for `file`, memory schema for mem_ingest_file fallback), the 2 Atlassian tools (`jira-attachment-tools.ts`, `confluence-content-tools.ts`) with their divergent `ALLOWED_BASES=[process.cwd()]`/`validateFilePath` containment explicitly noted as replaced by the shared resolver (TDD §6.4), and the extension-side tools (`embed-image.ts`, `stream-write.ts`, `Base64ProxyService.ts`) integrated via the extension `PathResolver` adapter (TDD §6.3). Added handler-location note; BR-20 uniformity preserved by contract + shared test matrix.
- **DISC-2 (Low): RESOLVED — FSD v1.1 §1.1, §1.2, §2.1, §3.1.4, §3.3.4, §3.3.6.** `sandbox_run` path argument corrected to `file` (schema `tool-definitions.ts:70`); §3.3.6 matrix no longer requires `file_path` on all 8 tools (7 of 8 + `file` exception); resolution applied host-side pre-mount per TDD Open Question #3.
- **DISC-3 (Low): RESOLVED — FSD v1.1 §3.3.4, §3.3.6 (+ §3.1.4 note).** `stream_write_file` wording aligned to TDD §3.3: parameter is `path` on the module variant and `file_path` on the code-intel and extension variants — both names accepted and routed through the resolver on every surface.
- **DISC-4 (Low): RESOLVED — FSD v1.1 §3.3.4.** `drawio_export_png` clarified: backend `file_path` is reference-only (backend writes to a temp dir and returns `output_base64`); `output_path` write-back is extension-side (output proxy, `output-proxy.ts:59`); resolver touches `file_path` (backend, reference) + `output_path` (extension proxy).
- **DISC-5 (Low): RESOLVED — FSD v1.1 §1.2, §3.2.1, §3.2.4, §3.2.6, §5.3, §6.1.** Config-file mechanism named: `MCP_WORKSPACE_ROOTS_FILE`, referencing the normative TDD §4.2 format (one root per line, `#` comments, blank lines skipped) and source precedence env var → file → legacy mode (no longer left undefined as "TDD §4").

Feedback loop iteration 1 (BA↔SA) closed: FSD v1.1 consistent with TDD v1.0; 0 Critical, 1 High + 4 Low findings all addressed in-document.
